=== .vscode/launch.json ===
{
  "version": "0.2.0",
  "configurations": [
    {
      "name": "Django: Run Server",
      "type": "debugpy",
      "request": "launch",
      "program": "${workspaceFolder}/manage.py",
      "args": [
        "runserver",
        "--noreload"
      ],
      "django": true,
      "justMyCode": true,
      "console": "integratedTerminal"
    },
    {
      "name": "Tailwind: Watch CSS",
      "type": "node",
      "request": "launch",
      "runtimeExecutable": "pnpm",
      "runtimeArgs": [
        "run",
        "watch:css"
      ],
      "console": "integratedTerminal"
    }
  ],
  "compounds": [
    {
      "name": "Django + Tailwind",
      "configurations": [
        "Django: Run Server",
        "Tailwind: Watch CSS"
      ],
      "stopAll": true
    }
  ]
}

=== WELCOME.md ===
# Welcome to Your Django Project!

## Getting Started

- The `Workspace: Start Dev` task starts Django and Tailwind in grouped integrated terminals.
- VS Code asks once whether to allow automatic tasks for this folder. Allow it to start the task on open, or run `Workspace: Start Dev` from the Tasks menu.

## Dev Startup Scripts
- `start-dev.sh` (macOS and Linux) and `start-dev.bat` (Windows) open this folder in a new VS Code window.
- Both need the `code` command on your PATH.

## Admin Setup
- `README.md` explains how to create a Django superuser.

## Project Structure
- `manage.py` - Django management script
- `templates/` - HTML templates when enabled
- `static/` - Static files
- `my-shop/` - Django project configuration
